english.title: Park a heavy commercial vehicle wholly / partly on land between two carriageways which is not a footway
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) parked a heavy commercial vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), wholly or partly on land between two carriageways and which was not a footway, namely **(..SPECIFY LOCATION..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 19(1) of the Road Traffic Act 1988 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.
